endorsements.name: Jason Schlesinger
endorsements.label: Cloud Security in Map/Reduce
endorsements.description: This presentation is an overview of the operations principles of Map/Reduce and Hadoop with examples of typical implementation in a business environment. It points out significant security issues that now exist and others that will certainly arise. The presentation also offers suggestions for improving security in existing installations, and presents improvements to provide security going forward.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 17

evidence-links.title: DEF CON 17 - Jason Schlesinger - Cloud Security in Map Reduce

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
